settings.title: 28" – 54" Tailored Elevation
settings.text: From a low-profile seated position to a commanding standing height, the Atlas adapts to your every move. A wide-range vertical axis designed to fit any user and any task with surgical accuracy.

settings.title: Smart Memory Integration
settings.text: Switch between your ideal positions instantly. Our intuitive control interface stores your preferred heights, allowing for seamless transitions so you can stay focused on what truly matters.

settings.title: Heavy-Duty Performance
settings.text: Power that feels weightless. Engineered to handle your entire professional setup with ease, ensuring the same smooth, quiet, and stable lift regardless of the equipment on your desk.

settings.title: Pc intelligent control program
settings.text: With seamless game compatibility and regular lighting function updates, the system allows for real-time lighting control and desktop adjustments. The lighting timer can be customized to align with your work and rest schedule, adjusting automatically from morning to evening.
Supports 4.4 – 44.1 lbs (2–20 kg)
Holds up to a 49" ultrawide screen
Wall-mount ready with integrated surge safety.

settings.title: ATLAS Proprietary Suite
settings.text: Designed in-house to work in perfect harmony with the Atlas architecture. Explore a modular, secure range of add-ons that evolve with your needs, ensuring every component feels like a native part of your workspace.

settings.title: Tüv Certified Drive System
settings.text: Powered by TÜV-validated motor technology. Engineered for whisper-quiet synchronization and long-term mechanical reliability, ensuring every height adjustment is as smooth as the first.

settings.title: BIFMA Certified Stability
settings.text: Tested to the most stringent BIFMA standards for structural integrity. Atlas maintains zero frame deflection under professional-grade payloads, ensuring a rock-solid foundation for any setup.

settings.title: Testing and certifications
settings.text: Rigorously tested to surpass BIFMA and global ergonomic standards. Through lab-verified stability and motor longevity tests, we ensure a workspace built for professional performance.

settings.heading: 1. Why use a standing gaming desk？
settings.content: A standing gaming desk reduces fatigue and improves posture during long gaming sessions. It also promotes better circulation, supports overall comfort, and gives you a more dynamic and engaging gaming setup.

settings.heading: 2. What makes the Atlas different from other standing gaming desks?
settings.content: The Atlas is designed for gamers and content creators, with RGB lighting, PC program synchronization, and the ability to match game algorithms for an immersive setup.

settings.heading: 3. Can I use the Atlas desk for gaming as well as work?
settings.content: Definitely. While it’s designed for gamers, the Atlas provides a versatile workspace suitable for productivity, streaming, or creative work.

settings.heading: 4. Can the Atlas desk handle heavy monitors or multiple devices?
settings.content: Yes, it’s built with a robust frame that supports heavy setups including multiple monitors, gaming gear, and accessories.

settings.heading: 5. Is the Atlas RGB lighting customizable?
settings.content: Yes. As a RGB gaming desk, the Atlas RGB lighting can connect to the game system through PC program and react to in-game actions. With over 1,000 interactive effects, it dynamically changes to match your gameplay, creating an immersive experience.

settings.heading: 6. What is the warranty on the Atlas desk?
settings.content: Every Atlas includes a 3-year warranty, just like all Blacklyte standing desks. For added protection, you can join our Extended Warranty Program to extend coverage by 2 more years and receive a $10 cashback.

settings.custom_liquid:
<script src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0663/6742/2695/files/gsap.min.js?v=1702624210"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0663/6742/2695/files/ScrollTrigger.min.js?v=1702624230"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0663/6742/2695/files/SplitText.min.js?v=1770282992"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0663/6742/2695/files/ScrollToPlugin.min.js?v=1770710796"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0663/6742/2695/files/ScrollSmoother.min.js?v=1772701772"></script>
<script>
  (() => {
    gsap.registerPlugin(
      ScrollTrigger,
      SplitText,
      ScrollToPlugin,
      ScrollSmoother,
    );

    ScrollTrigger.config({
      limitCallbacks: true,
      ignoreMobileResize: true,
    });

    let isInited = false;
    let isProgrammaticScroll = false;
    let video = null;
    // const video = document.querySelector(".buypage_section_16_video");
    // if (video.hasAttribute("loop")) {
    //   video.removeAttribute("loop");
    // }

    function checkInit() {
      if (window.innerWidth > 1000 && !isInited) {
        isInited = true;
        initPage();
      }
    }

    function boot() {
      checkInit();
    }

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
    } else {
      boot();
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", checkInit);

    async function initPage() {
      // 1️⃣ 等 DOM
      await domReady();

      video = document.querySelector(".buypage_section_16_video");
      if (!video) return;

      if (video.hasAttribute("loop")) {
        video.removeAttribute("loop");
      }
      // initScroller();
      // 2️⃣ 等关键媒体资源
      await _playVideo();

      // 3️⃣ 初始化 Pin 类 section（必须在前）
      initPinnedSections();

      // ⚠️ 关键 refresh（pin 占位计算）
      ScrollTrigger.refresh();

      // 4️⃣ 初始化普通进入动画 section
      initNormalSections();

      // 5️⃣ 最终 refresh（锁定所有 trigger）
      ScrollTrigger.refresh();

      gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

      const anchor_items = document.querySelectorAll(
        ".features_navbar_anchor_item",
      );
      anchor_items.forEach((item) => {
        item.addEventListener("click", () => {
          isProgrammaticScroll = true;

          setTimeout(() => {
            isProgrammaticScroll = false;
          }, 500);
        });
      });
    }

    function domReady() {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        if (document.readyState === "loading") {
          document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", resolve);
        } else {
          resolve();
        }
      });
    }

    function initScroller() {
      ScrollSmoother.create({
        content: "#MainContent",
        wrapper: ".body-content-wrapper",
        smooth: 2,
        effects: false,
        normalizeScroll: true,
        preventDefault: true,
      });
    }

    function initPinnedSections() {
      initVideoScrollSection16();
      initSectio14();
    }

    function initVideoScrollSection16() {
      const section = document.querySelector(".buypage_section_16");
      if (!section) return;

      const video = section.querySelector(".buypage_section_16_video");
      const mask = section.querySelector(".buypage_section_16_mask");
      const info = section.querySelector(".buypage_section_16_info");

      // 视频控制
      ScrollTrigger.create({
        trigger: section,
        start: "top 20%",
        onEnter: () => {
          video.currentTime = 0;
          video.play().catch(() => {});
        },
        onLeave: () => {
          video.pause();
          video.currentTime = 0;
        },
        onEnterBack: () => {
          video.play().catch(() => {});
        },
      });

      // pin动画
      const tl = gsap.timeline({
        scrollTrigger: {
          trigger: section,
          start: "top top",
          end: "+=140%",
          scrub: true,
          pin: true,
          anticipatePin: 1,
        },
      });

      tl.fromTo(mask, { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1, duration: 1 }, 0);

      tl.fromTo(
        info,
        { y: "100%", opacity: 0 },
        { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 1.2 },
        0.2,
      );

      tl.to({}, { duration: 2 });
    }

    let section16TextPlayed = false;

    function playSection16Text(info) {
      if (section16TextPlayed) return;
      section16TextPlayed = true;

      const subtitle = info.querySelector(".buypage_section_16_subtitle");
      const boxes = info.querySelectorAll(".buypage_section_16_box");

      const split = new SplitText(subtitle, { type: "chars" });
      gsap.set([split], {
        autoAlpha: 0,
      });

      const tl = gsap.timeline();

      tl.from(split.chars, {
        y: 20,
        autoAlpha: 0,
        stagger: 0.02,
        duration: 0.6,
        onComplete: () => split.revert(),
      });

      boxes.forEach((box) => {
        tl.from(
          box,
          {
            y: "50%",
            autoAlpha: 0,
            duration: 0.6,
          },
          "-=0.3",
        );
      });
    }

    function initNormalSections() {
      initSection6();
      initSectio11();
      initSectio1();
      initCombineSection();
      initSectio13();
      initSectio15();
      initCompareSection();
      initSpecsSectin();
      initFaqSection();
      initVoiceSection();
    }

    function initSection6() {
      const section = document.querySelector(".buypage_section_6");
      if (!section) return;

      const img = section.querySelector(".first_part_img");
      const extras = section.querySelectorAll(".first_part_img_extra_item");
      const title = new SplitText(section.querySelector(".first_part_title"), {
        type: "chars",
      });
      const text = new SplitText(section.querySelector(".first_part_text"), {
        type: "lines",
        linesClass: "line",
      });

      gsap.set([img, extras], { autoAlpha: 0, y: 40 });
      gsap.set([title, text], { autoAlpha: 0 });

      const tl = gsap.timeline({
        scrollTrigger: {
          trigger: section,
          start: "top bottom",
          toggleActions: "play none none none",
          once: true,
          invalidateOnRefresh: true,
        },
      });

      tl.add(() => {
        gsap.from(title.chars, {
          y: 20,
          autoAlpha: 0,
          stagger: 0.04,
          duration: 1,
          onComplete() {
            title.revert();
          },
        });
        gsap.from(
          text.lines,
          {
            yPercent: 100,
            opacity: 0,
            stagger: 0.1,
            duration: 0.6,
            onComplete() {
              text.revert();
            },
          },
          "-=0.3",
        );
        gsap.to(img, { y: 0, autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.6 }, "-=0.3");
        gsap.to(
          extras,
          {
            y: 0,
            autoAlpha: 1,
            stagger: 0.25,
            duration: 0.6,
          },
          "-=0.3",
        );
      });
    }

    function initSectio11() {
      const section = document.querySelector(".buypage_section_11");
      if (!section) return;

      const item_contain_left = section.querySelector(".item_contain_left");
      const item_contain_tab_box = section.querySelector(
        ".item_contain_tab_box",
      );
      const item_contain_right_tab = section.querySelectorAll(
        ".item_contain_right_tab",

    function _initializeVideo() {
      const _observer = new IntersectionObserver(
        _handleVideoIntersect.bind(this),
        { threshold: 0 },
      );
      _observer.observe(document.querySelector(".buypage_section_16"));
    }

    function _handleVideoIntersect(entries_, observer_) {
      entries_.forEach(
        function (entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            _playVideo();
          } else {
            _pauseVideo();
          }
        }.bind(this),
      );
    }

    function _playVideo() {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        if (!video) {
          resolve();
          return;
        }

        if (video.readyState >= 1) {
          resolve(video);
          return;
        }

        const done = () => {
          video.removeEventListener("loadedmetadata", done);
          video.removeEventListener("loadeddata", done);
          resolve(video);
        };

        video.addEventListener("loadedmetadata", done, { once: true });
        video.addEventListener("loadeddata", done, { once: true });

        const playPromise = video.play();
        if (playPromise) {
          playPromise.then(() => video.pause()).catch(() => {});
        }

        setTimeout(() => resolve(video), 2000);
      });
    }
    function _pauseVideo() {
      if (!video.paused) {
        video.pause();
      }
    }

    function _isValidVideoDuration(video_) {
      var duration = video_.duration;
      if (isFinite(duration) && !isNaN(duration)) {
        console.log("Video Duration is valid:", duration);
        return true;
      } else {
        console.log("Video Duration is not valid:", duration);
        return false;
      }
    }

    function _setVideoScrub() {
      if (!video.paused) {
        video.pause();
      }
    }
